title: AI Study Coach
tagline: An intelligent study assistant transforming raw lecture notes into active recall flashcards and quiz evaluations.
description: Created to streamline my own CS exam preparation across operating systems, database management, and computer networks.

screenshots.title: Interactive Quiz Interface
screenshots.caption: Instant active-recall feedback on CS concept notes

architecture: Web UI -> FastAPI Parser -> Local LLM JSON Validator -> Spaced Repetition Engine
database: Local storage index storing flashcard decks, SRS review intervals, and historical quiz scores.
folderStructure:
ai-study-coach/
├── backend/
│   ├── app/parser.py
│   └── app/prompt_templates.py
├── frontend/
│   └── src/components/QuizCard.tsx
└── README.md
timeline: Early 2026: Prompt template design & JSON schema validation
challenges: Enforcing deterministic JSON schema outputs from open-source LLMs without hallucinated keys.
lessons: Prompt validation and JSON schema enforcement are essential when relying on local open-source language models.
futureImprovements: Implement SuperMemo-2 (SM-2) spaced repetition algorithm for optimal card review scheduling.
